title: Controller's Memorandum on Reopening, Refunding and Resettling Guest Folios after the Stay
content:
Under the Guest Folios rules of every Ashbury brand, a settled folio is reopened by guest services only to post a correction allowed under the folio correction rules or a credit allowed under the elite breakfast benefit, and only where the brand permits a settled folio to be reopened. A folio is reopened only if the request is made no later than the brand's dispute window in calendar days after the guest checked out. Days are counted as whole calendar days from the actual check-out date, which is day zero; a request on the last day of the window is accepted. A folio that needs no correction is not reopened.

When the corrections leave a credit balance, the credit is refunded in full to the card the folio was settled to, where the brand refunds credits only to that card; it is never paid in cash, moved to another folio or converted to points. A refund is posted only on a folio whose status is reopened, and its amount equals the credit balance. Once the balance is zero the folio is settled again with the date of the new settlement.

## The life of a corrected folio

| Status | What may happen | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Settled | Reopened by guest services | A correction or breakfast credit is allowed, the brand permits reopening, and the request is within the dispute window |
| Reopened | Refund of the credit balance to the card the folio was settled to | The balance is a credit (below zero); the refund equals that credit |
| Reopened, balance zero | Settled again | Dated the day of the new settlement |

## The refund amount

The refund is the credit balance in full: where the balance due after the corrections is below zero, the refund is that balance without its minus sign; where the balance is zero or above, there is no credit and no refund.

| Hypothetical balance after corrections | Refund |
|---|---|
| Credit of $42.75 (balance of minus $42.75) | $42.75 to the card the folio was settled to |
| $0.00 | None; the folio is settled again |

## The reopening window

| Hypothetical case (window of 60 calendar days) | Actual check-out date | Request date | Day | Reopened |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Last day of the window | 1 July | 30 August | Day 60 | Yes, if a correction is allowed |
| One day later | 1 July | 31 August | Day 61 | No |

## Basis questions

**May the credit be paid to the guest in cash, or moved to the guest's next folio?** No. It is refunded in full to the card the folio was settled to, and never paid in cash, moved to another folio or converted to points.

**The guest wants the bill reopened to look at it again, with no line to correct.** A folio that needs no correction is not reopened.
